usageNotes: Returns the SDN (Software-Defined Networking) directory index for a specific PDM node, listing available SDN sub-resources. Because it requires no privileges beyond a valid session, it is useful for probing whether SDN capabilities are exposed on a given node before issuing more specific SDN calls. The endpoint returns null per the schema, meaning it functions as a navigation anchor rather than a data payload.
tips: Returns null data — treat this as a directory listing stub; actual SDN configuration is retrieved through child endpoints under /nodes/{node}/sdn/.
Accessible with any valid API token (permissions: all), so safe to call for capability discovery without elevated credentials.
